thesis: AMPH is a profitable, cheap-on-multiples stock in a clean uptrend with accelerating revenue growth and a recent earnings beat, and it is holding up while the Nasdaq sells off. The pullback entry at 28.8-29.5 offers a defined stop under the swing low, and a breakout through 31.00 would target 32.16. High short interest adds squeeze fuel on a breakout. The setup is still modest, not strong: reward/risk to 31.00 alone is weak, the analyst target is below price, and the regime is risk-off, so this deserves small, patient sizing at best.
evidence: fundamentals: notes = revenue +8.2% YoY (207.6M vs 191.8M), net income 37.8M vs 17.4M a year earlier, forward P/E 8.9
fundamentals: red_flags = Short interest 21.7% of float: squeeze potential
news: event_risks = No S-3/424B5/8-K in the last 10 days, so no offering risk is visible
regime_view: leading_sectors = XLY, XLP, XLU (defensive/consumer areas holding up; AMPH is not in the semis/tech-led sell-off)
